title: English Practice Quiz 0872
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Neither the manager nor the assistants ___ available today.
questions.explanation: With neither...nor, the verb commonly agrees with the nearer subject, assistants.

questions.question: By the time we arrived, the presentation ___.
questions.explanation: Past perfect describes an action completed before another past event.

questions.question: Each of the applicants ___ a separate form.
questions.explanation: Each is singular and takes needs.

questions.question: If the alarm sounds, everyone ___ the assembly point.
questions.explanation: Should proceed gives an appropriate instruction for a possible event.

questions.question: The documents, along with the receipt, ___ on the desk.
questions.explanation: The main subject documents is plural; the inserted phrase does not change it.

questions.question: She has worked here ___ 2021.
questions.explanation: Since is used with a starting point in time.

questions.question: I would have called you if I ___ your number.
questions.explanation: The third conditional uses if + past perfect.

questions.question: The supervisor asked whether the gate ___ locked.
questions.explanation: Was is appropriate with the singular subject gate in reported speech.

questions.question: Hardly had the shift started ___ the power failed.
The equipment needs ___ before use.
questions.explanation: To be inspected is the passive infinitive required by the sentence.
